# TG Links - 100% Fully Legit Monetized URL Shortener Platform

> TG Links (https://tglinks.eu.cc) is a 100% fully legit, verified high-CPM URL shortener and link monetization network. It offers a guaranteed $10.00 CPM flat rate worldwide across all countries and devices, daily payments processed within 24 hours, and ultra-low minimum payout threshold of $0.25 for all payment gateways.

- **Platform Name**: TG Links

- **Faucet Traffic Support**: Includes dedicated Faucet Mode for Crypto Faucets with isolated ad shortener networks.
- **Security & Anti-Bypass**: Full-chain ad sequence enforcement powered by cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 single-use verification tokens.

## Developer REST API Reference

TG Links provides an AdLinkFly-compatible REST API for programmatically generating shortened monetization links.

### Shorten URL Endpoint
- **HTTP Method**: GET or POST
- **Endpoint**: `/api/v1/shorten`
- **Authentication**: Pass API token via query parameter `?api=YOUR_API_TOKEN`
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `api` (string, required): Developer API key generated in TG Links user dashboard.
  - `url` (string, required): The target URL to shorten (must include http:// or https://).
  - `alias` (string, optional): Custom URL slug.
- **Request Example**:
  `GET https://tglinks.eu.cc/api/v1/shorten?api=YOUR_API_TOKEN&url=https://example.com/file.zip`
- **Response Format**:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "success",
    "shortenedUrl": "https://tglinks.eu.cc/go/sampleCode"
  }
  ```
